hero.title: Facilities for a More Comfortable Stay
hero.description: From warm pools to everyday hotel services, Green Hero Darajat provides facilities that support your time staying with family.
hero.imageAlt: Green Hero Darajat, the warm pool, and the mountain panorama at dusk

pools.title: Pools & Relaxation
pools.description: The pool area is one of the main experiences during your stay, perfect for relaxation and family time amid the cool air of the Darajat mountains.
pools.imageAlt: A guest soaking in the warm pool of Green Hero Darajat with mountain views
pools.note: No spa service is provided. The focus is purely on the warmth of the natural mountain sulfur water.

dining.title: Restaurant & Breakfast
dining.description: Enjoy food and drinks without having to leave the hotel area. A selection of warm Sundanese breakfasts and Archipelago dishes is served fresh every morning with a misty valley panorama.
dining.imageAlt: An Archipelago-style breakfast dish on a table near the window with a Darajat view

restaurant.title: Restaurant & Dining Lounge
restaurant.description: A family dining spot with open mountain views

breakfast.title: Breakfast Buffet & À La Carte
breakfast.description: A choice of Archipelago breakfast menus, delicious porridge, and warm tea

roomService.title: 24-Hour Room Service
roomService.description: Delivery of hot dishes straight to your room door

family.title: Comfortable for Families
family.description: Designed so the stay experience stays comfortable for parents and children. Enjoy the open green area set against tea plantations and a safe, easily supervised shallow kids' pool.
family.imageAlt: A wooden villa with a garden and children's play area at Green Hero Darajat

friendly.title: Family-friendly environment
friendly.description: A lush, clean, and noise-free area for private family recreation

kidsPool.title: Kids pool with safe depth
kidsPool.description: Warm water at a comfortable temperature with a toddler-friendly depth

garden.title: Children-friendly open garden & seating
garden.description: A wide grass garden for little ones to explore safely

connectivity.title: Parking & Connectivity
connectivity.description: Basic facilities that help keep your trip practical during your stay in Darajat. Easy vehicle access with a spacious parking area in front of the lobby and a stable internet connection.
connectivity.imageAlt: The parking area and resort entrance surrounded by mountain trees

parking.title: Free Guest Parking
parking.description: A spacious paved parking area for private vehicles and tourist buses

wifi.title: Free High-Speed Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Fiber-optic internet access throughout all public resort areas

roomWifi.title: Wi-Fi in Rooms & Suites
roomWifi.description: Stable connectivity inside every room unit for relaxed working comfort

services.title: Services That Help During Your Stay
services.description: Our staff are dedicated to delivering distinctive West Javanese hospitality with prompt service throughout the day.

frontDesk.title: 24-Hour Front Desk
frontDesk.description: A receptionist on standby 24 hours to handle late check-ins, amenity needs, and Darajat tour guidance.

housekeeping.title: Daily Housekeeping
housekeeping.description: Daily room cleaning maintains freshness, linen hygiene, and maximum comfort of your rest space.

luggage.title: Luggage Storage
luggage.description: Safe storage of your suitcases and belongings before check-in time or after check-out so you can roam freely.

roomService.title: Room Service
roomService.description: Delivery service for hot food, afternoon snacks, and warm drinks straight to your room or villa.

rooms.title: Comfort in Every Room
rooms.description: Every accommodation at Green Hero Darajat is equipped with high-comfort standard facilities to ensure a peaceful rest.
rooms.note: Some facilities may differ based on room type, stay period, or hotel operational policy. Please check the details on each room when making a reservation.

bathroom.title: Private Bathroom
bathroom.description: A clean bathroom with modern sanitary ware and complete bath amenities.

shower.title: Natural Hot Water Shower
shower.description: A refreshing flow of natural warm sulfur water from the Darajat crater.

bathtub.title: Soaking Bathtub
bathtub.description: A private soaking tub for maximum relaxation with natural warm water.

minibar.title: Minibar & Tea/Coffee Maker
minibar.description: Electric kettle, ceramic cups, bottled mineral water, and a selection of Garut tea.

refrigerator.title: Refrigerator
refrigerator.description: A mini fridge to store cold drinks and Garut specialty souvenirs.

kitchenette.title: Kitchenette / Mini Kitchen
kitchenette.description: A dishwashing area and a simple kitchen counter for the comfort of families on long stays.

experiencesCta.title: Want a More Complete Experience?
experiencesCta.description: Add Green Hero Experiences options such as a special Roast Goat dish, an evening BBQ & Grill, a Birthday Celebration, or a romantic Room Decoration during your booking process.

bookingCta.title: Ready to Stay at Green Hero Darajat?
bookingCta.description: Choose your stay dates and find available rooms for your family holiday in the cool air of Garut.

footer.about: A family-friendly mountain resort with natural sulfur hot springs in the Darajat highlands of Pasirwangi, Garut, West Java.
